summary: Phase 18 testing complete. All 14 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend smoke confirms the new sidebar structure (USER/LEAGUE HUB/SOCIAL/MANAGEMENT/DRAFT) renders exactly as specified, /league-info loads with Constitution tab, save+persist+5000-char truncation work, /scoring alias works, Standings Last-5 dots are grey for 0-game teams (60/60 dots have data-testid suffix '-none'), /live MY MATCHUP card displays full data for H2H league and is correctly hidden after switching to Stat Chasers Roto. issues: Pre-existing socket.io WebSocket warning still present (non-blocking, carried over from iteration 15).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~4200 lines — should still be split into routers/ by domain.

Constitution endpoint exposes audit_log entries via /api/leagues/{id}/audit-log returning the raw mongo doc (id field is renamed but no Pydantic response model). Consider adding a typed AuditLogEvent response model so the contract is documented and ObjectId leaks are impossible.
/api/leagues/{id}/constitution GET endpoint is unauthenticated — fine for read but consider whether constitution text should be visible to non-members of a private league.

The constitution endpoint inserts to BOTH db.audit_log and db.activity_feed in the same handler — good user-visibility, but the activity_feed write is wrapped in try/except that silently swallows exceptions (line 688). Log the exception so silent persistence failures don't go unnoticed.
